--SELECT * FROM EDS.CI_DEMOG_RETAIL_VW order by emailaddress desc

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME IN ('TSK_CI_EDS_CI_Demographics_Retail') ORDER BY 8 desc

SELECT * FROM [OM].[OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL] WHERE TASK_NAME IN ('TSK_CI_EDS_CI_Demographics_Retail')

CREATE VIEW EDS.CI_DEMOG_RETAIL_VW AS

/*
List down all Customers and their balances using the DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER data.
*/
WITH DEP AS
(
    SELECT 
        DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
        ,ORGKEY
        ,SUM(OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP) AS OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
        --,SUM(MONTH_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP) AS MONTH_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
        ,SUM(CASE WHEN DAH.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN ISNULL(DAH.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP,0)
		ELSE ISNULL(NONPHP.YTD_BALANCE_PHP,0) END) AS YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
    FROM eds.EDS_CTL AS CTL
        INNER JOIN eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS DAH
        ON CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE = DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD NONPHP
        	ON DAH.GAM_ACID = NONPHP.GAM_ACID
        	AND DAH.GAM_BANK_ID = NONPHP.GAM_BANK_ID
        	AND DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE = NONPHP.FULLDATE
        	AND NONPHP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
    WHERE DAH.AAS_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
	AND DAH.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
	AND DAH.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'
        --AND CTL.CRM_DATE = CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE AND CTL.CRM_DATE = CTL.LOANS_DATE
    GROUP BY DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE, ORGKEY
)
/*
List down all Customers and their balances using the LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER data.
*/



, LNS AS
(
    SELECT 
        LAH.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
        ,CUST.ORGKEY
        ,SUM(RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP) AS RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
        ,SUM(BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP) AS BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP
        ,SUM(CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP) AS CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP
    FROM eds.EDS_CTL AS CTL
        INNER JOIN eds.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_AAS_VW AS LAH
        ON CTL.LOANS_DATE = LAH.AS_OF_DATE
	INNER JOIN eds.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
		ON LAH.CUST_ID = CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND LAH.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID
		AND LAH.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND SCD_END_DATE
    WHERE LAH.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
	AND LAH.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J')
	AND LAH.LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'
        --AND CTL.CRM_DATE = CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE AND CTL.CRM_DATE = CTL.LOANS_DATE
    GROUP BY LAH.AS_OF_DATE, CUST.ORGKEY
)
/*
Get the total balances per Customer.
*/
, CI_CUSTOMER_BALANCES AS
(
SELECT 
    B.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,A.ORGKEY AS FCBS_CIF
    ,SUM(B.TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP) AS TOTAL_DEPOSIT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    ,SUM(B.TOTAL_YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP) AS TOTAL_DEPOSIT_YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
    ,SUM(B.TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP) AS TOTAL_LOAN_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,SUM(B.TOTAL_BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP) AS TOTAL_LOAN_BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP
    ,SUM(B.TOTAL_CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP) AS TOTAL_LOAN_CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP
    ,A.BANK_ID
    ,A.SOURCE_CODE
FROM eds.CUSTOMER_DIM A
/*
Combine the DEP & LNS balances for all the Customers.
*/
    INNER JOIN
    (
    SELECT 
        AS_OF_DATE
        ,ORGKEY
        ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
        ,YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP AS TOTAL_YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
        ,0 AS TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
        ,0 AS TOTAL_BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP
        ,0 AS TOTAL_CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP
    FROM DEP
    UNION
    SELECT 
        AS_OF_DATE
        ,ORGKEY
        ,0 AS TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
        ,0 AS TOTAL_YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
        ,RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP AS TOTAL_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
        ,BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP AS TOTAL_BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP
        ,CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP AS TOTAL_CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP
    FROM LNS
    ) B
        ON A.ORGKEY = B.ORGKEY
        AND B.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN A.SCD_START_DATE AND A.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE A.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
GROUP BY B.AS_OF_DATE, A.ORGKEY, A.BANK_ID, A.SOURCE_CODE
)
/*
Summarize the Customer information and join the total balances.
This follows the file format from original CI Staging data from Oct 2023.
Use this dataset to load to Dynamics Customer Insights.
*/

SELECT TOP 1250000
CUST.ORGKEY	AS	CustomerID
,CUST.NAME	AS	CustomerName
,NULL	AS	GlobalCIF
,CUST.ORGKEY	AS	EntityCIF
,CUST.ORGKEY	AS	FCBSCIF
,CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE	AS	CustomerType
,CUST.CUST_DOB	AS	Birthdate
,LEFT(CUST_DOB,4) as Birthdate_Masked
,CUST.MARITAL_STATUS	AS	MaritalStatus
,CUST.GENDER_DESCRIPTION	AS	Gender
,CUST.MOBILE_NUMBER	AS	MobileNumber
,CASE WHEN MOBILE_NUMBER IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(MOBILE_NUMBER,1,CHARINDEX(')',MOBILE_NUMBER)),'*******') END as MobileNumber_Masked
,CUST.EMAIL_ADDRESS	AS	EmailAddress
,CASE WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%@%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(EMAIL_ADDRESS,CHARINDEX('@',EMAIL_ADDRESS),LEN(EMAIL_ADDRESS))) ELSE '*******' END as EmailAddress_Masked
,CUST.ADDRESS_LINE1	AS	AddressLine1
,CUST.ADDRESS_LINE2	AS	AddressLine2
,MV_CITY.DESCRIPTION	AS	City
,MV_STATE.DESCRIPTION	AS	Province
,CUST.ZIP	AS	ZipCode
,MV_COUNTRY.DESCRIPTION	AS	Country
,NULL	AS	Nationality
,NULL	AS	EmployerName
,NULL	AS	OfficeAddressLine1
,NULL	AS	OfficeAddressLine2
,NULL	AS	OfficeCity
,NULL	AS	OfficeProvince
,NULL	AS	OfficeZipCode
,NULL	AS	OfficeCountry
,NULL	AS	Industry
,CUST.OCCUPATION_DESCRIPTION	AS	Occupation
,DATEDIFF(yy, CUST.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE, DATEADD (hh , 8 , getdate()))	AS	Tenure
,AGG_BAL.TOTAL_DEPOSIT_YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP	AS	TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalRelationshipBalance_Prorated
,NULL	AS	TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
,AGG_BAL.TOTAL_DEPOSIT_YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP	AS	TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Prorated
,AGG_BAL.TOTAL_DEPOSIT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP	AS	TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Prorated
,AGG_BAL.TOTAL_LOAN_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP	AS	TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Prorated
,AGG_BAL.TOTAL_LOAN_BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP	AS	TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Prorated
,AGG_BAL.TOTAL_LOAN_CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP	AS	TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalCreditLimitLoans_Prorated
,NULL	AS	TotalOutBalPHPCards
,NULL	AS	TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,NULL	AS	TotalCreditLimitCards
,NULL	AS	TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Prorated
,NULL	AS	TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Prorated
,NULL	AS	TotalFundValueTrust_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalFundValueTrust_Prorated
,NULL	AS	TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
,NULL	AS	TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Prorated
,CUST.DATA_PRIVACY_CONSENT	AS	DataPrivacyConsent
,CUST.LAST_KYC_DATE	AS	LastKYCDate
,CUST.RISK_RATING_TYPE	AS	RiskRatingType
,CUST.RISK_RATING_NAME	AS	RiskRating
,NULL	AS	SuspendedIndicator
,CUST.ATM_ENROLLMENT	AS	ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,CUST.MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT	AS	MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,CUST.ONLINE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT	AS	RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator
,NULL	AS	PayrollIndicator
,NULL	AS	GenerationalCohort
,NULL	AS	MarketSegment
,AS_OF_DATE	AS	LastUpdatedDate
,AS_OF_DATE	AS	BusinessDate
,'CRM'	AS	SourceSystemCode
,'CBC01'	AS	BankCode
FROM eds.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL CTL
        ON CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
    LEFT JOIN eds.MV_CITY_DIM AS MV_CITY
        ON CUST.CITY = MV_CITY.VALUE
        AND CUST.BANK_ID = MV_CITY.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN eds.MV_STATE_DIM AS MV_STATE
        ON CUST.STATE = MV_STATE.VALUE
        AND CUST.BANK_ID = MV_STATE.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN eds.MV_COUNTRY_DIM AS MV_COUNTRY
        ON CUST.COUNTRY = MV_COUNTRY.VALUE
        AND CUST.BANK_ID = MV_COUNTRY.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN CI_CUSTOMER_BALANCES AGG_BAL
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = AGG_BAL.FCBS_CIF
        AND CUST.BANK_ID = AGG_BAL.BANK_ID
WHERE CUST.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) = 'R'
--AND AGG_BAL.TOTAL_DEPOSIT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP > 500000 --Removed 20240821 RTSF
--ORDER BY AGG_BAL.TOTAL_DEPOSIT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP DESC --Changed 20240821 RTSF
ORDER BY AGG_BAL.TOTAL_DEPOSIT_YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP DESC
